summary: xAI launched Build Mode, a beta feature in Grok that generates working websites, apps, games and dashboards live in chat and lets users publish them via a shareable link.

practices.reason: The feature describes a chat-driven build-and-iterate loop for generating live app previews, but the underlying scaffolding and gains are not specified in enough detail to implement.
practices.quote: Tell Grok an idea, and it builds a working version live in your chat, on the web or your phone.
